meta.name: security-owasp-web
meta.description: Review or design a web, API, or mobile-backend system against the current OWASP Top 10 risk categories, including the 2025 order: broken access control, security misconfiguration, software supply chain failures, cryptographic failures, injection, insecure design, authentication failures, software or data integrity failures, security logging and alerting failures, and mishandling of exceptional conditions. Produces a per-category status table, evidence list, residual risks, and a remediation plan that maps each finding to a code or configuration owner. Use before any web/API/mobile-backend release, on every major change to auth, data flows, third-party integrations, exception handling, or supply chain, and as a recurring gate alongside qa-eval and pr-review.

copy.tagline: 审查应用安全,对照 OWASP Top 10 输出风险证据与修复计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责 Web 应用或接口的安全审查,需要对照行业标准找漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Audit app security against OWASP Top 10 and get risk evidence with a fix plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage web app security and need to find vulnerabilities against industry standards.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按 OWASP Top 10 对 Web、API 或移动后端做安全审查,产出逐类别的状态表、证据清单、残余风险和修复计划,将每个发现对应到代码或配置负责人,并给出可发布的门禁结论(Go/Conditional/Hold)。
howto.when: 在 Web/API/移动后端发布前,或对认证、数据流、第三方集成等做重大变更时;也可作为与 qa-eval、pr-review 并行的定期安全门禁。

say.text: 发布前按 OWASP Top 10 审查这个服务,给出整改清单。
say.note: Claude 会逐类检查并列出负责人。

say.text: 用 OWASP 检查一下认证和权限设计是否有漏洞。
say.note: 它会返回每个类别的状态和证据路径。

say.text: 对第三方集成和供应链做一次 OWASP 审查,说明残余风险。
say.note: 会结合依赖清单给出风险和修复建议。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reviews web/API/mobile-backend against OWASP Top 10, giving per-category status table, evidence list, residual risks, remediation plan with owners, and release gate verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered before any web/API/mobile-backend release, on major changes to auth, data flows, third-party integrations, or supply chain, and as a recurring security gate with qa-eval and pr-review.

say_en.text: Before release, review this service against OWASP Top 10 and give a fix list.
say_en.note: Claude checks each category and lists owners.

say_en.text: Use OWASP to check the authentication and permission design for flaws.
say_en.note: It returns status and evidence paths per category.

say_en.text: Run an OWASP review on third-party integrations and supply chain, stating residual risks.
say_en.note: It uses dependency manifests to give risks and fixes.
